reviews.title: Doesn’t open
reviews.text: When I try to open this app it just goes to the Home Screen. Have tried re downloading with same result. Pity, looks useful.

reviews.title: False mac compatibility
reviews.text: Being on the Apple app store in the first place would imply that the app is compatible with Apple devices. However, going onto it on an unaltered (relevant for later) Mac, will result in it reporting that the Mac is "rooted", which is purely an android term, that if it was applied to a Mac would imply that the Mac's OS was tampered with/edited, which it hasn't been.

reviews.title: not clear enough
reviews.text: Was looking for advice that is precise with reminders built in so I prune, feed, etc. my garden plants. I found the advice such as pruning imprecise as must be auto generated. For example they gave both options to prune an evergreen and deciduous hedge together. It should just define what to do and when to do it with an option to add into a calendar. Will wait until more precise as I can google this info.

reviews.title: So Clunky
reviews.text: Just awful. Some screens don’t fit on an iPhone, took three tries just to subscribe even though my bank approved it, lots of fluff but couldn’t sctually do what I wanted so cancelled a years subscription
Nothing to say if it is free or not until one is well into the signing up and personal information, then it is suddenly sprung on you. My time would have been better spent in the garden.

reviews.title: Not free
reviews.text: It is promoted is a free app but you can’t even try it without putting in your payment details. Not reasonable

reviews.title: Waste of time.
reviews.text: Full of pop ups and data gathering just to identify plants.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: I was really excited to get this app - it has all of the features I think I’ll need in one place. There are so many glitches however. Whenever I use the AI tool it crashes and “My Garden” often shows as empty even though I’ve added current plants and wish list plants. I then add them again and the other appear. Frustrating. I’d really like it to work but looks like I’ll have to cancel before my free trial ends

reviews.title: Cost
reviews.text: No mention of cost until you sign up to an account (which you have to do) and then once they have all your details you’re asked for payment. Sneaky. Not for me if that’s how they operate.

reviews.title: Pay to use
reviews.text: Only after you register to use the app do you then get told to pay.

reviews.title: Kimbo65
reviews.text: Misleading - it’s not a free app

reviews.title: Cant access app
reviews.text: Wont let me put in a password when signing up. Cant even access the app

reviews.title: Not working
reviews.text: Paid a month ago, it keeps asking me to verify my email and won’t let me access the app until I do but I am unable to verify as it doesn’t send me an email sp that I can verify. Why does it want me to verify again and block me in the meantime, I signed up and paid so why?? It only worked during the two week trial period, not since I paid £35 for a year. And yes, the money has come out of my bank account. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: Too Glitchy for a paid app
reviews.text: Too many glitches, takes ages to load regardless of WiFi speed, tools not available, way to poor to pay for when it’s this unreliable, how to I get a refund?

reviews.title: App not working...
reviews.text: The App has stopped working on my iPhone. Just stuck on the "Loading" screen. I've tried deleting and reinstalling but makes no difference. Disappointing as I like the App use it quite a lot. But pretty useless if it doesn't load.

reviews.title: Stuck at loading
reviews.text: Downloaded for first time got stuck on loading screen, deleted and re-downloaded twice, same thing both times so have given up with it

reviews.title: Just Unreliable in my experience
reviews.text: Rarely loads, have to re-enter details every time and takes an age of it ever does.

reviews.title: NOT FREE
reviews.text: It gets all your information before revealing to you that you have to pay

reviews.title: Lags
reviews.text: Doesn’t work, lags and doesn’t load properly. Not an issue with WiFi as other apps work fine.

reviews.title: Why not be upfront about the monthly cost?
reviews.text: The app harvests your email and location before requiring a subscription to go any further.  There’s a “free” trial but you have to pay upfront and then cancel  rather than try it out with no pressure.

reviews.title: Expensive
reviews.text:
As an RHS member, I feel I’m paying twice if I want access to any of the useful features. Yes, I can set up a list of my plants, but I can do that with pen and paper, so why bother?
Why not bundle it in to membership as an optional extra for another £5/10?

reviews.title: not free
reviews.text: not for free

reviews.title: App not working
reviews.text: Sorry this app not open not working

reviews.title: Not worth the subscription
reviews.text: I took out a subscription because I wanted to use the plant identifier. It worked brilliantly to begin with, then a big update basically killed it. Now it crashes every time I try to use it, often requiring 2 or 3 app restarts to get it to work. £5.99 a month isn't cheap, especially when the rest of the info and advice is available for free on RHS's own website, so its not unreasonable to want the tool to work. Subsection now cancelled in favour of Picture This, which is cheaper and actually works.

reviews.title: A mean App.
reviews.text: Lured in by the promise of being able to use a feature that helps you choose a planting combination, and to keep records of your garden. Which you can do, but on if you PAY every month. So nothing else of use really that you can't find in the internet anyway. No free tools available. Disappointing for the Royal Horticultural Society.

reviews.title: Need to pay for any value
reviews.text: You need to pay a subscription for this app if you want any of the useful features. Basically just good for a list of all my plants…

reviews.title: Plant ID has changed
reviews.text: Since the plant id layout has changed I cannot get a photograph identified.

reviews.title: Plant non identifier
reviews.text: Plant identifier still not working - and when it does the results are not always accurate. Other apps do this much better for a lower subscription fee. Feels like the app has been launched without proper user testing.

reviews.title: Rubbish
reviews.text:
This app used to work well for me, every month you could easily see what needed to be done for the specific plants in my garden. However, it has somehow lost this functionality and is now useless. I have contacted RHS several
times for help and nothing done. Very annoying.

reviews.title: Caution - requires subscription
reviews.text: Just be aware that the main features worth having are subscription only. The app doesn’t really have useful features in the free version. And you only discover this once you’ve coughed up all your personal information. To be honest I’d expected better from the RHS. Disappointing.

reviews.title: Why?
reviews.text: I am already a fully paid up RHS member so why do you ask me to pay £5.99 a month for information I can already get

reviews.title: Absolutely AWFUL App and annual subscription charged out of nowhere when cancelled!!!
reviews.text:
This app was signed up for a free trial from 5.12.25 to 19.12.25 ONLY, and then out of the blue I was charged for the FULL YEAR of £39.99. The subscription ended and I even checked at the time and then despite the cancellation, on 29.12.25 a full year’s charge of £39.99 was debited to my card. This app is awful as it was unable to identify my plants, so to resurrect the membership out of the blue is TOTALLY unacceptable!!!!!! 
PLEASE REFUND MY MONEY IMMEDIATELY!
